extraction_evidence.method: release archive extracted and boot partition inspected; only the documented boot-layout contract is reused

meson1.dtb.observed: vendor 4.9 FDT (amlogic-dt-id sm1_ac213_2g); incompatible with the mainline kernel the image boots

ddr_usb_relationship.relationship: paired with aml_sdc_burn.UBOOT in the verified stock input set
ddr_usb_relationship.sd_image_action: aml_sdc_burn.UBOOT, ddr-usb.bin and meson1.dtb are not written to the SD image; they are retained for provenance/recovery only

generated_inputs.kernel: target rootfs /vmlinuz (Debian linux-image-arm64), resolved inside the rootfs to /boot; gzip payloads are decompressed to a raw arm64 Image
generated_inputs.ramdisk: target rootfs /initrd.img (initramfs-tools), resolved inside the rootfs to /boot
generated_inputs.dtb: mainline DTB from the same kernel package: /usr/lib/linux-image-<kver>/<build/targets mainline_boot.device_tree>
generated_inputs.android_legacy_header: AshipaOS self-contained legacy v0 writer; page size 2048; kernel at 0x01000000 + Image text_offset
